participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Made him a carrier, and left the spare unoffered for tomorrow.
participation.name: Thomas Hobbins

relations.quote: You've only the one horse too many.

story.body: You gave him the share and not the crown, and you did not name an opening. He gave you the horse too many, and you kept it.

relations.quote: You've only the one horse too many.

title: Said the share, and kept the one horse too many
